adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Mantis joins Quill in the hunt for Gamora and holds Thanos down on Titan, until Quill's rage breaks her hold. She turns to dust as she helps him to his feet.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mantis's teammate, whose rage breaks her hold on Thanos.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Quill's teammate, who holds Thanos down on Titan.
adds.evidence: Infinity War: Quill, Drax and Mantis go to Knowhere then Titan; Mantis subdues Thanos, Quill attacks on learning of Gamora's death and breaks the hold; Mantis disintegrates while helping Quill up.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Restored by the Blip, Mantis comes through Strange's portal with Quill to fight Thanos's army, then flies off with him and Thor on the Benatar.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mantis's teammate, back from the Blip with her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Quill's teammate, back from the Blip with him.
adds.evidence: Endgame: Strange tells Mantis, Quill, Drax and Parker five years passed and portals them to the battle; afterwards the Guardians pick up Thor in New Asgard, Mantis joining the Quill/Thor leadership banter.

adds.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
adds.text: Mantis and Quill travel the galaxy with Thor and go to him together to ask for his help in a battle on Indigarr.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mantis's teammate, who goes with her to ask Thor for help.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Quill's teammate, who goes with him to ask Thor for help.
adds.evidence: Love and Thunder, Battle of Indigarr: Mantis and Star-Lord go to the meditating Thor to ask for help, then return to the battle together.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Mantis worries about her grieving brother and tries to give him advice through Drax. After they save Rocket, she leaves the Guardians to find her own path as Quill heads home to Earth.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mantis's half-brother, who heads home to Earth as she leaves.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Quill's half-sister, who leaves the Guardians to find her own path.
adds.evidence: Vol. 3: Mantis frets over Quill, feeds Drax advice for him, screams as he freezes in space; at the end Quill announces he is returning to Earth and Mantis says she is leaving to discover what she wants.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
adds.text: May helps Peter get ready for his homecoming date, then walks in on him wearing his Spider-Man suit.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: May's nephew, whom she catches in his Spider-Man suit.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, who walks in on him in his Spider-Man suit.
adds.evidence: Homecoming: May gives Peter a suit and teaches him to dance before the dance; days later she walks into his room and finds him in the Spider-Man suit.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Restored by the Blip, May stands beside Peter at Tony Stark's funeral.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: May's nephew, beside her at Tony Stark's funeral.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, beside him at Tony Stark's funeral.
adds.evidence: Endgame: May, restored by the Blip, attends Tony Stark's funeral with Peter (pictured together on Fandom's May page). A shared scene, but little passes between them.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
adds.text: May knows Peter is Spider-Man and slips his suit into his bag for the class trip to Europe, then meets him at the airport when he gets home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: May's nephew, whose suit she packs for his trip to Europe.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, who packs his suit for his trip to Europe.
adds.evidence: Far From Home: May hugs Peter while he packs and later puts his suit in his suitcase; she greets him at Newark airport on his return.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
adds.text: Peter visits May's grave often, and a memory of her telling him she loves him for who he is helps him reach Jean Grey. At her grave he vows to stop doing everything alone.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: May's nephew, who still visits her grave.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's late aunt, whose words still guide him.
adds.evidence: Brand New Day: Parker regularly visits May's grave; Jean experiences his memory of May saying she loves him for who he is; at May's grave he vows to stop trying to do everything alone.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#2
adds.text: May wakes from the healing pod to find a Life Model Decoy of Coulson and tells him he is not Coulson, since the real one is still dead. She keeps him at a distance as they work together again.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A Life Model Decoy of May's old love, whom she won't treat as Coulson.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's old partner, who won't treat him as the real Coulson.
adds.evidence: S7 'Know Your Onions' (S7#2): Coulson LMD stops an erratic May, who reacts apathetically ('You still are' dead); through S7 they work missions together, argue in S7#6 that she is tired of mourning him, and in S7#12 he says he likes who she has become.

adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: When Kree soldiers attack the Khan home, Muneeba throws herself over Yusuf to shield him, and the two follow Nick Fury to a space station while Kamala fights in space.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Muneeba's husband, whom she shields from Kree soldiers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Yusuf's wife, who shields him from Kree soldiers.
adds.evidence: The Marvels: Muneeba plants her body over the knocked-down Yusuf as a Kree guard strikes; the Khans go with Fury to the S.A.B.E.R. station; Yusuf consoles Muneeba when Kamala returns crying.

adds.title: Thor: The Dark World
adds.text: Odin and Thor clash over Jane Foster and over how to face the Dark Elves after Frigga's death, and Thor defies his father to take Jane off Asgard.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Odin's son, who defies him to take Jane off Asgard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's father, whom he defies to take Jane off Asgard.
adds.evidence: The Dark World: Odin urges Thor toward Sif rather than Jane, warns of the Aether; after Frigga dies Thor recruits Loki and leaves with Jane against Odin; Thor later declines the throne.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: Peggy dies in her sleep, and Steve helps carry her coffin at her funeral in London.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Peggy's old love, who carries her coffin at her funeral.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's old love, whose coffin he carries at her funeral.
adds.evidence: Civil War: Peggy dies in her sleep at ninety-five; Steve serves as a pallbearer at her London funeral, where Sharon gives the eulogy.

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: Pepper gets Tony to take on the Avengers Initiative, and before he flies a nuclear missile into space he tries to call her, but she misses the call.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Pepper's partner, who calls her before flying a nuke into space.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's partner, whom he calls before flying a nuke into space.
adds.evidence: The Avengers: Pepper convinces Stark to read Coulson's files and help; during the battle Stark has J.A.R.V.I.S. call her before the nuke, she misses it watching on a plane; afterwards they redesign the tower together.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: Killian kidnaps Pepper and puts Extremis in her, and she kills him to save Tony. Afterwards Tony destroys his suits for her and has the shrapnel taken out of his chest.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Pepper's partner, who destroys his suits for her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's partner, who kills Killian to save him.
adds.evidence: Iron Man 3: Killian kidnaps Potts and subjects her to Extremis; she kills Killian to save Stark; Stark destroys all suits as a gesture of devotion, stabilizes her, and has the shrapnel removed.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
adds.text: Tony and Pepper are back together, and when Peter turns down the Avengers, Tony asks Happy for the ring he has kept for years to announce their engagement to the press.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Pepper's partner, who gets out a ring to announce their engagement.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's partner, whose engagement he is ready to announce.
adds.evidence: Homecoming: Potts arranges the press conference for Spider-Man; when Peter declines, Stark asks Hogan for the ring and plans to propose publicly; Potts says she can improvise something better.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Tony tells Pepper of a dream about their future child, Morgan, then rushes off with Doctor Strange and ends up on an alien ship as she begs him to come home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Pepper's fiancé, who ends up on an alien ship as she begs him home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's fiancée, who begs him to come home.
adds.evidence: Infinity War: jogging in Central Park Stark tells Potts of a dream about a child named Morgan; Strange arrives; later Potts calls and begs him to get off the Q-Ship until the signal cuts out.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: In Kraglin's story of young Peter's first Christmas with the Ravagers, Yondu kicks over his tree, then secretly gives him the pair of blasters he still carries.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Quill's foster father, who gives him his blasters one Christmas.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Yondu's foster son, given his blasters one Christmas.
adds.evidence: Holiday Special: Kraglin tells how Yondu ruined Christmas for young Quill (animated flashback: Yondu kicks the tree away, then leaves two Quad Blasters on Quill's bed); Quill tells Mantis Yondu gifted him the blasters he still uses.

adds.title: WandaVision#8
adds.text: Wanda relives her childhood in Sokovia, where Pietro pulls her under the bed when a shell hits their home and the two wait for days beside an unexploded Stark bomb.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Pietro's twin sister, who relives their childhood in Sokovia.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's twin brother, who shelters her under the bed as a boy.
adds.evidence: WandaVision #8 'Previously On' (flashbacks): mortar shell kills their parents, Pietro leads Wanda under the bed, they are trapped two days facing a Stark Industries shell; Wanda also tells Vision the only comfort would be seeing Pietro again.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: A Proxima from 2014 comes forward in time with Thanos and leads his army against the Avengers, and she turns to dust with him when Tony snaps.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Proxima's adoptive father, who brings her forward in time to fight.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Thanos's adopted daughter, who leads his army against the Avengers.
adds.evidence: Endgame: 2014 Thanos brings his forces, including Proxima, to 2023 and summons them to the Compound ruins; Proxima leads his army; Stark's snap dusts her and Thanos. Both are 2014 variants, which the app's cast already treats as the same people.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Ramonda rules Wakanda while Shuri is gone in the Blip, and when Shuri returns the two reunite at the Citadel.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ramonda's daughter, back from the Blip.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's mother, who rules Wakanda while she is gone.
adds.evidence: Endgame: Ramonda survived the Snap and led Wakanda; after the Blip she reunites with T'Challa and Shuri at the Citadel in Birnin Zana as the city celebrates.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Ramonda rules Wakanda while T'Challa is gone in the Blip, and when he returns the two reunite at the Citadel.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ramonda's son, back from the Blip.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's mother, who rules Wakanda while he is gone.
adds.evidence: Endgame: Ramonda survived the Snap and led Wakanda; after the Blip she reunites with T'Challa and Shuri at the Citadel in Birnin Zana as the city celebrates.

owner_calls.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
owner_calls.question: Add a stage where Peter learns Ego put the tumor in his mother's head and turns on Ego to avenge her? It is about Meredith, but Ego does it and she is long dead.
options: Add family stage: 'Peter learns that his father gave his mother the tumor that killed her, and he turns on Ego to avenge her.'
owner_calls.evidence: Ego admits he put the tumor in Meredith's head; Peter, enraged, helps destroy Ego.

owner_calls.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
owner_calls.question: Fandom says Sharon is on the phone with her aunt when she runs into Steve in the hallway. As far as the sources say, Peggy isn't named on screen. Add a stage for that call?
options: Add family stage on the phone call
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom's Sharon Carter page links 'aunt' to Peggy for the laundry scene; the film shows only one side of the call.

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#2
owner_calls.question: In S7, Coulson is a Chronicom LMD and Fandom treats him as a separate character. Keep the proposed S7 stage on the real Coulson's tie, and is friend the right kind?
options: Keep on this tie as friend (proposed)
Keep on this tie as partner
Leave S7 off this tie (LMD is someone else)
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom page 'Phil Coulson/Chronicom LMD'; May tells him he is not Coulson in S7#2 and slowly accepts him by S7#12.

owner_calls.title: WandaVision#5
owner_calls.question: From WandaVision#5, Agatha has Ralph Bohner pose as Pietro, Wanda's brother, in Westview. If the app links him to pietro-maximoff, should that impostor get a stage on this tie, or does it belong to a Ralph Bohner tie?
options: Stage at WandaVision#5 for the impostor
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom: Agatha enthralled Ralph Bohner into posing as Pietro (WV105), freed in WV109.
